target_customer: Podcast listeners and podcasters who want social discovery and feedback
problem: Podcast apps were solitary and discovery was weak. Breaker added episode comments, likes and friend activity to a standard player.
business_model: free consumer app with a plan to sign exclusive premium podcasts and charge about 6 dollars a month

founders.name: Leah Culver
founders.background_notes: Per the YC page: iOS and Python developer, co-author of OAuth and oEmbed specs, angel investor.

exit.reason: Twitter hired the team to help build Twitter Spaces; Breaker said it would close its apps on January 15, 2021, with Maple Media later taking over operations.

technical_complexity.rationale: A podcast player with a social layer on iOS is standard mobile work, built by essentially two people.

defensibility.rationale: Podcast content was open and identical on every other app, so only the social graph could lock users in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Large platforms kept podcast features free and broad; Twitter hired the team in January 2021 rather than keeping the product.

market_need_then: YC page reported a 67 percent one month retention rate for beta users; podcast listening was growing in 2017 and early users said it replaced Overcast as their default player, though demand was small relative to incumbents.

branding.domain_note: Used breaker.audio, not a .com; it now redirects to player.fm.

identity.logo: Wave icon from a friend's artwork inspired by Hokusai's woodblock print, later cropped over a sunset background

branding.brand_signature: The social podcast app positioning and wave icon

rebrands.why: A redesign described in the company's own post; reasons not read in detail.

branding.community_and_virality: The App Store listing claimed over 370,000 listeners; Product Hunt coverage and a company podcast called Breaking Ground.

brand_strength.rationale: Good launch press and a recognizable wave icon with an engaged niche, but a small base and no evidence the name drove growth.

outcome_analysis: Breaker launched in March 2017 as the social podcast app and reached a niche following, but its social layer sat on content freely available in every other player and its premium plan was never shown to work. Twitter acquired the team in January 2021 for Spaces and the app was to shut down. The cause is partly inferred, as the company's own statement gives only the team move.
notes: Only a dead-startups aggregator mentions a seed round with undisclosed size; no rounds recorded. YC lists only Leah Culver as founder; a press result names Erik Berlin as co-founder and CEO, not listed here because the YC page does not. Product Hunt coverage suggests competitors Overcast, Pocket Casts and Castro but no dated source was opened, so the list is empty. An aggregator claims Breaker was relaunched as a reskin of Player FM, unverified; the redirect to player.fm is consistent with it. Failure and success tags are interpretation. Rebrand date 2019 is not confirmed from a dated source.
